chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Hamadani from Mu'ttab from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) or he said from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him)

He said: One day he said, 'O Mu'ttab! Seek out fresh fish for us, for I intend to get cupping done.' So I sought it out, then came to him with it, so he said to me, 'O Mu'ttab! Cook part of it in vinegar for us, and grill part of it for us.' So he had lunch from it, and Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) had dinner.
ai.seo_question: What did the Imam eat before cupping according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the practical wisdom of the Imams, specifically Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), who utilized fresh fish as a dietary aid to facilitate cupping therapy (hijama), a common medical practice of the era. The specific preparation—preserving half and grilling the other half—demonstrates an early example of food preservation techniques and the Sunnah of utilizing available resources efficiently for health and sustenance.
